# Spout DirectX SDK

Unmodified minimal DirectX 11 source set from https://github.com/leadedge/Spout2
at `c2bcc12147711d12ace7d5f08e869d774d840f8a` (2.007.017).

`SpoutDX.{h,cpp}` comes from `SPOUTSDK/SpoutDirectX/SpoutDX`; its support files
come from `SPOUTSDK/SpoutGL`. Copyright Lynn Jarvis and contributors, BSD-2-Clause.
See LICENSE and the retained individual source notices.

Built statically into the separate AutoVJ video sender; no Spout application,
virtual camera, SDK example or installer is bundled.
